generation.scope: On both signed fixed elliptic curves at every ordinary characteristic-zero slope, the geometric support of the length-five defect equals that of the length-four defect. It consists of the twelve old sections and the four positive opposite-determinant sections, with the four negative pairs coincident when lambda squared times z equals minus one.

proof_review.scope: Reviewed localization factors, quadratic conjugate and norm, unit row scaling, finite resultants on the four remaining families, and lower semicontinuity of rank on the old sections.

mathematical_computation.scope: Verified 344 invertible pivots on the quadratic algebra, exact residual two-variable rank minors and projected common roots for all sixteen companion and endpoint matrices, and function-field quintic profiles of the twelve old sections.

tex.engine: LuaHBTeX; no overfull boxes, missing glyphs or undefined references

open_mathematics: At (z,lambda)=(3,2), construct the length-six insertion matrix by first quotienting the three disjoint adjacent pairs. Compute its character targets and compare independent maximal minors on both fixed curves outside the quartic support, including geometric points not rational over the sampling primes. If a new defect is found, certify its residue field and all starting positions; otherwise prove saturation or use the central quartic finite-quotient test to address higher lengths.
